programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Their Digi-Tal Friends; Pups Save the Rainbow
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol must save the day when two overly helpful robots take on more than they can handle; in a dream, Mayor Humdinger finds a prism that makes rainbows and drains Adventure Bay of color; the pups must restore color to Adventure Bay.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Big Bad Bird Crew; Pups Save a Soapbox Derby
programs.desc: Myrna the Mynah bird leads her new feathered friends astray, and it's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue the wayward flock; Adventure Bay is holding a "kids only" soapbox derby race when a mysterious newcomer named Hum-Kid shows up, breaking the rules.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Rubble-Double; Pups Save a Clown
programs.desc: Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double; the Pups must save Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Fire Rescue: Pups Save a Baby Goat Birthday; Fire Rescue: Pups Save a S'more-Mergency
programs.desc: When Farmer Yumi and Al's baby goat birthday party goes up in flames, they call on the Fire Rescue Pups to put it out; Mayor Humdinger goes camping and has just one thing on his mind: s'mores, but roasting marshmallows turns into a disaster.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Floating Goodways; Pups Save the Portable Pet Wash
programs.desc: The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan-shaped float and need rescue from a flock of real swans aiming to protect the giant inflatable; Mayor Humdinger steals Katie's Portable Pet Wash and ends up causing bubble trouble all over town.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem ; Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
programs.desc: Before Chickaletta's play date with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap and gets stuck; Mayor Humdinger loses his voice.
